articles.title: Two Weird New Sea Spiders Found — One Has Hairy Feet and Red Eyes!
articles.summary: Scientists found two brand-new sea spider species in the Salish Sea — the first in nearly 100 years! One has hairy legs and creepy red eyes. The other is named after an ancient village where waves crash.

articles.title: Harvest Moon Lights Up the Sky This Weekend — With Saturn as a Bonus!
articles.summary: The famous Harvest Moon rises Saturday, Sept. 26 — the first full moon of autumn. Look east after sunset, and you'll spot bright Saturn shining right below it. No telescope needed!

articles.title: Dead Star Creates a Shock Wave That Scientists Say Shouldn't Exist
articles.summary: Astronomers found a dead star blasting out a giant shock wave — but according to science, it shouldn't be able to. The star has no disc of material, which is usually needed. It's a cosmic mystery!
